notes.title: She's Off.
notes.body: Molly left for Kona yesterday and arrived safely.  She arrived safely, was settling in, and headed to worship when Karen spoke to her last night.  Hawaii is six hours behind.  A hurricane is headed toward Hawaii, so the next couple of days should be interesting.  More to come....Molly's Dad.
